tagline: Photo filters & editor for iPhone & iPad
liveTitle: Coming Soon to the App Store
liveDesc: A calm, fast photo editor for iPhone and iPad with elegant filters, versioning, and private iCloud sync.
heroCompat: for iPhone & iPad · iOS 18+ · Native Swift & SwiftUI
hoverInspect: Hover or tap module to inspect details
guideDesc: Explore 20 walkthrough steps from the initial launch to versioned photo workflows.
aboutTitle: A calm photo editor built around your originals.
aboutDesc: Engineered exclusively for iOS and iPadOS. Every edit is saved as a version, keeping your original untouched. Zero ads, zero tracking, and complete privacy.
supportDesc: Write to us: hakobghlijyan@gmail.com — we reply as soon as we can.
privacyIntro: The app does not collect your personal data. Zero accounts, zero ads, and zero analytics.
footerTrademark: Apple, iPhone, iPad, and App Store are trademarks of Apple Inc.
onboarding.footnote: Your photos stay on your device.
onboarding.card1.title: Filters & Adjustments
onboarding.card1.subtitle: Apply Core Image filters and tune brightness, contrast and saturation with live previews.
onboarding.card2.title: Crop & Watermarks
onboarding.card2.subtitle: Pick an aspect ratio and add one of eight watermark styles.
onboarding.card3.title: Your Library
onboarding.card3.subtitle: Every edit is saved as a version, so you can always return to the original.
onboarding.page1.title: Start in seconds
onboarding.page1.desc: Drop a photo onto the canvas, or try a preset first — no access to your library needed.
onboarding.page2.title: Your photos, your choice
onboarding.page2.desc: Pick a frame from your library. FilterStudio only asks for what it needs.
onboarding.page3.title: A guide in one tap
onboarding.page3.desc: The ⓘ button shows the steps: import, filter, crop, watermark, save.
onboarding.page4.title: Start from the original
onboarding.page4.desc: Your photo is never changed. Every edit becomes a new version.
onboarding.page5.title: Swipe through filters
onboarding.page5.desc: Preview each look live, then fine-tune brightness, contrast and saturation.
onboarding.page6.title: Crop to any ratio
onboarding.page6.desc: Square, portrait, wide — pick the frame for where the photo will live.
onboarding.page7.title: Add a watermark
onboarding.page7.desc: Eight styles built from the photo’s own data: camera, EXIF, film frame and more.
onboarding.page8.title: See it before you save
onboarding.page8.desc: Check the final result, then save a new version.
onboarding.page9.title: Saved as a version
onboarding.page9.desc: Each save adds a new frame to your gallery. The original stays untouched.
onboarding.page10.title: Your gallery
onboarding.page10.desc: All edited frames in one place, with the date they were captured or saved.
onboarding.page11.title: Sort your way
onboarding.page11.desc: Newest first, by day or by month — find a frame in seconds.
onboarding.page12.title: Resize the grid
onboarding.page12.desc: Switch between Small, Medium and Large to see more or look closer.
onboarding.page13.title: Collections, made for you
onboarding.page13.desc: Recent days, favourites, albums and filters — organised automatically.
onboarding.page14.title: Your library in numbers
onboarding.page14.desc: See how many photos you add and how your library grows.
onboarding.page15.title: Delete without worry
onboarding.page15.desc: Deleted photos wait in Recently Deleted. Restore them any time before the countdown ends.
onboarding.page16.title: Choose the quality
onboarding.page16.desc: Pick the JPEG quality that suits you. Location and EXIF are always kept.
onboarding.page17.title: See what’s stored
onboarding.page17.desc: Originals, versions, thumbnails and trash — every byte accounted for.
onboarding.page18.title: Local or iCloud
onboarding.page18.desc: Keep everything on this device, or sync across your devices with iCloud.
onboarding.page19.title: Light or dark
onboarding.page19.desc: Match the system, or pick your own look. Every screen adapts.
onboarding.page20.title: Private by design
onboarding.page20.desc: Your photos stay yours. Replay this tour any time from Settings.
help.title: How it works
help.add_text: Pick one from Photos or drag and drop an image onto the canvas.
help.filters_text: Swipe through the filters, then fine-tune brightness, contrast and saturation.
help.crop_text: Choose a crop and add a watermark built from the photo’s own data.
help.save_text: Every save becomes a new frame in your gallery. The original is never changed.
